title: Compatible strict henselizations with integral geometric residue maps
statement: Let g:T→S be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme]. Let k,k′ be separably closed fields [def-pc-separably-closed], σ:Spec k→S and τ:Spec k′→T integral geometric points [def-weil-geometric-point], and ι:Spec k′→Spec k satisfy ι≫σ=τ≫g. Integral means that each point factors through the residue field of its image by an integral field homomorphism [def-weil-residue-field]. Let Ω be an algebraically closed field and ν:Spec Ω→Spec k′ any field-spectrum morphism. Set s=ν≫ι≫σ and t=ν≫τ. There exist strictly henselian local rings A,B [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology], isomorphisms eA:Spec A≅S_(s) and eB:Spec B≅T_(t) to the strict henselization schemes [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], a local homomorphism φ:A→B, and universal homeomorphisms ρA:Spec k→Spec κA and ρB:Spec k′→Spec κB. Writing jA=eA≫j_s and jB=eB≫j_t for the canonical structural maps [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map], rA,rB for the closed-point maps, and i0 for the residue-field map induced by φ, one has Spec φ≫jA=jB≫g, ρA≫rA≫jA=σ, ρB≫rB≫jB=τ, and ρB≫i0=ι≫ρA. This result is purely geometric and contains no sheaf or cohomology.

proof.text: Obtain compatible strict henselization rings, their affine models, geometric residue maps and factorization equations from the existing core theorem.

For these fixed models, choose a local map inducing the specified residue square using the corrected residue-square completion theorem. Repack the original rings and residue maps with this new local map and its structural equality.

lean.statement:
theorem Etale.projectiveLine_compatibleStrictHenselizationResidues
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} {g : T ⟶ S}
    {k k' Ω : Type u} [Field k] [IsSepClosed k] [Field k'] [IsSepClosed k']
    [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (σ : Spec (.of k) ⟶ S) (τ : Spec (.of k') ⟶ T)
    (ι : Spec (.of k') ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (hι : ι ≫ σ = τ ≫ g)
    (hσ : ∃ (s : S) (ψ : S.residueField s ⟶ .of k),
      ψ.hom.IsIntegral ∧ Spec.map ψ ≫ S.fromSpecResidueField s = σ)
    (hτ : ∃ (t : T) (ψ : T.residueField t ⟶ .of k'),
      ψ.hom.IsIntegral ∧ Spec.map ψ ≫ T.fromSpecResidueField t = τ)
    (ν : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of k')) :
    let s := ν ≫ ι ≫ σ
    let t := ν ≫ τ
    ∃ (A B : Type u) (cA : CommRing A) (cB : CommRing B),
      letI := cA
      letI := cB
      ∃ (hA : HenselianLocalRing A) (hB : HenselianLocalRing B),
        letI := hA
        letI := hB
        ∃ (sA : IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A))
          (sB : IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B)),
          letI := sA
          letI := sB
          ∃ (φ : A →+* B) (hφ : IsLocalHom φ),
            letI := hφ
            ∃ (eA : Spec (.of A) ≅ strictLocalization s)
              (eB : Spec (.of B) ≅ strictLocalization t)
              (ρA : Spec (.of k) ⟶ Spec (.of (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)))
              (ρB : Spec (.of k') ⟶ Spec (.of (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B))),
              IsUniversalHomeomorphism ρA ∧ IsUniversalHomeomorphism ρB ∧
              Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ≫ eA.hom ≫ strictLocalizationToBase s =
                eB.hom ≫ strictLocalizationToBase t ≫ g ∧
              ρA ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue A)) ≫
                eA.hom ≫ strictLocalizationToBase s = σ ∧
              ρB ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue B)) ≫
                eB.hom ≫ strictLocalizationToBase t = τ ∧
              ρB ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map φ)) =
                ι ≫ ρA
